newsitem.title: USA: Castle Energy wins $10 mln in arbitration.
newsitem.headline: Castle Energy wins $10 mln in arbitration.

text.p: Castle Energy Corp on Monday said it expected to receive $10 million from a unit of Metallgesellschaft AG as a result of an arbitration decision in its favor.
Castle said that the two companies underwent arbitration in a dispute over receivables from its Powerine refinery in Los Angeles.
The company said it expected to collect a $10 million note from the German company no later than October 14.
The company said the arbitrator's decision would not affect its annual earnings because it had not recorded any reserve against the Metallgesellschaft note.
Castle Energy, which is not affiliated with Castle Oil Corp, owns interests in about 300 oil and gas wells located primarily in the Appalachian basin of the United States.
Castle Energy shares fell 1/4 to 12-1/2 on Monday.
